titulo: What If Every Human Disappeared? The Last Thing Left of Us
premisa: Every human on Earth disappears at once. The viewer, as an invisible witness, watches the planet search for the 'last proof that we existed.' Each time jump eliminates a candidate. 1 HOUR: with nobody feeding fuel to the power plants, the grid starts to fail; nuclear reactors shut down on their own (automatic SCRAM), but their cooling pools depend on backup diesel generators that will eventually run dry. 1 DAY: the New York subway, which pumps out about 13 million gallons of water every day, starts to flood within roughly 36 hours (Alan Weisman, The World Without Us); there are already blackouts across entire cities. 1 YEAR: the real-world proof is Chernobyl, where wolves, horses and wild boar took over the exclusion zone; pets go feral, and weeds crack the asphalt. 100 YEARS: unpainted steel rusts, many bridges collapse, and wooden houses rot and fall; forests swallow the suburbs. 10,000 YEARS: the cities are mounds covered in forest... but something is still standing.
gancho: If every human vanished right now… what would be the LAST thing proving we were ever here?
